class.name: RenderSceneDataRD
class.brief_description: Render scene data implementation for the RenderingDevice based renderers.
class.description: Object holds scene data related to rendering a single frame of a viewport. See also [RenderSceneData], [RenderData], and [RenderDataRD]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal rendering server object. Do not instantiate this class from a script.

method.name: get_temporal_upscaler_data
method.description: Returns temporal metadata for a custom upscaler: renderer-normalized projection [code]jitter[/code], [code]delta_seconds[/code], [code]z_near[/code], [code]z_far[/code], vertical [code]fovy[/code] in radians, and an unjittered [code]reprojection[/code] matrix from the current camera to the previous frame. Convert [code]jitter[/code] to pixel offsets by multiplying by the internal render size and [code]0.5[/code]. Access this data during the viewport upscaler's render callback. The returned values describe the current render operation.
